scope: Local read-only source/recipe inventory for the original 16 experiment PRs plus ranked-25 hypotheses; no B300 connection, profiles, optimizer steps, fits, remote edits, publication, or spending performed by this review.

execution_context.operator_report: Root reports B300 environment/data delivery is working and 147 source files plus canonical 61-file trainer identity are verified.
execution_context.fit_or_profile_status: not inspected by this review; no result is claimed
execution_context.no_false_ready_rule: A native CLI surface means implementation reuse only; every proposed family remains blocked on its listed recipe, control, lineage, actual B300 profile, cell-owner, and resource gates.
execution_context.attribution: The original PR account is not evidence of proposal authorship by named collaborators; preserve each PR source SHA and do not invent authorship.

ranked1_recipe.qualification: The two SHA-256 values cover different byte representations; 9292... is the LF Git-object/source revision binding, while ef3c... is the current CRLF checkout file. Do not compare them as if they hash identical bytes.

current_priority_after_rank1.why: Direct native GRU shapes; freeze measured-compute recipe before a controlled CP30 comparison.
Group-age versus field-age feature modes are source-native; confirm draft semantics, clean lineage, FP32 recipe and confound control.
Native innovation path has same-width zero-innovation control; historical cache-schema issue needs repair or explicit successor registration.
Small source-native moment-vs-zero-block family; this is a useful partial test, not the full raw/normalized ranked hypothesis.
Flag exists but admit only after BPTT toy parity and actual-shape resource profile; high-cost lower-ranked follow-up.

issue16_rank1_anchor.scope: F2/seed1001 pair only: fresh H512x1 wide vs H384x2 deep; six epochs; B8/C2000; strict FP32; epoch5 fixed endpoint; no validation selection; original labels only.
dependencies: Bind real cluster-readable data paths and actual scheduler/worker identity; Beleriand UUID/systemd paths are not cluster commands.
Run bounded actual-shape engineering profiles, then both matched fits on same provider/GPU/runtime.
Claim only rr18_r01_wide_f2_s1001 and rr18_r01_deep_f2_s1001; F0/seed1001 belongs to Beleriand, F1/seed1001 is outside issue scope.
Return identities, resource receipts, checkpoints, FP32 predictions/sidecars and official grades; include failures.

source_attribution_caution: All PRs list repository account VladKochetov007 as author; do not attribute proposal authorship to named collaborators without commit/coauthor evidence.

historic_queue_infrastructure_review.b300_allocation_or_inventory_present: Inventory observed by root; no allocation verified
historic_queue_infrastructure_review.trainer_limit: The audited canonical runner is single-process: no process group, rank/device binding, sequence sharding, gradient reduction, or collective metric path. Do not wrap the current CLI in torchrun and assume it becomes DDP.
historic_queue_infrastructure_review.single_gpu_controller: bandit_resources.py uses one global lock and is a single-GPU guard; it cannot schedule eight GPU workers.
historic_queue_infrastructure_review.current_cell_ownership: F0/seed1001 belongs to active Beleriand rank-1 work; issue #16 is F2/seed1001 only. Reconcile claims before assigning. F1/seed1001 is separately prepared for DataSphere and outside issue #16.
historic_queue_infrastructure_review.staging: Stage source data/cache once on shared fast storage when possible; bind manifests/input identities, writable persistent artifacts and physical-disk scratch.
historic_queue_infrastructure_review.ddp_requirements: Only after actual implementation: deterministic complete-sequence sharding; equal collective/update counts; global masked-objective denominators before scaling/clipping; global sufficient statistics for official pooled metrics; rank-separated logs and synchronized per-rank checkpoint state.
historic_queue_infrastructure_review.precision: Strict FP32; autocast/GradScaler off, TF32 off and float32 matmul precision highest; log/check actual attention/scan backend.
historic_queue_infrastructure_review.placement: If each candidate/control fits one card, place four matched pairs on eight cards per wave, arms sharing host/runtime. A larger teacher using multiple cards needs a correctly implemented DDP path and matched effective global batch/update budget.
historic_queue_infrastructure_review.scope: Two successful read-only SSH inventories; no assigned UUIDs, topology, runtime, scheduler or cgroup-delegation receipt.

historical_review_adjudications: In-sample KD on fitting groups is valid when all ancestors exclude the evaluated outer fold. Inner OOF is a distinct optional arm, not a universal blocker.
Scorer clipping does not mandate clipped teacher targets. Maxim's raw family targets versus current trainer clipping remain a real replication difference.
PR2 and R4 rank1 share an architecture lineage, not an identical comparison: PR2 compute matching is not R4's near-parameter matching.
SSH hardware visibility was observed; allocation, topology, stack and performance remain unverified.
Proposal readiness is distinct from SQLite runnable-job admission. No experimental fits are admitted.
